text:
maria.nguyen: Heads-up: CI eval runners are stalling during quantized-model onboarding jobs this morning. Queue saturation + flaky runner restarts look like the likely culprit. Proposing a lightweight GH Actions healthcheck + a circuit-breaker to skip heavy eval matrices when queue_depth > 30.

josh.kim: Do we have logs showing runner wait times? If self-hosted runners hit max connections then jobs just sit. Last night I saw several jobs in DEDX group waiting ~5-10m.

maria.nguyen: Yep, here are a couple snippets from the controller logs: `allocator: no available runner after 300s` and `job_wait_ms=320000`. Thinking we add a pre-check job that decides whether to run the full matrix. Example quick sketch:
```yaml
name: eval-healthcheck
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  check-queue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      depth: ${{ steps.query.outputs.depth }}
    steps:
      - name: query queue
        id: query
        run: scripts/ci/queue_status.sh --json > out.json && echo "::set-output name=depth::$(jq .depth out.json)"
  run-evals:
    needs: check-queue
    if: ${{ needs.check-queue.outputs.depth && (needs.check-queue.outputs.depth < '30') }}
    uses: ./.github/workflows/eval-matrix.yml
```

tara.lee: Agree on healthcheck. We should also formalize metrics we record so dashboards and alerting can act on them: `ci_queue_depth`, `eval_runner_uptime`, `eval_pass_rate`, and `eval_ci_skips`. Dashboards: grafana -> prometheus/evals -> dashboard `evals/ci-health`. If queue_depth > 30 for >5m mark nightly as degraded and notify #eng-oncall.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite notice: 3 jobs enqueued on dedx-runner group; avg wait=6m 12s; runner pool size=8

maria.nguyen: Plan: (1) Add GH Actions pre-check that returns non-zero (or skips) to avoid triggering the heavy matrix; (2) Add a circuit-breaker hook in the Buildkite plugin to cancel or pause heavy pipelines when queue_depth>30; (3) Emit metric `eval_ci_skips` when we skip; (4) Surface a small panel in evals/ci-health. I'll open the GH Actions PR with the snippet above.

josh.kim: Also for PR gating: for PRs touching `/evals/*` run a fast smoke job (20 examples) and require `eval_pass_rate >= 0.85` to pass gating. Full-nightly stays optional unless the repo owner opt-in. The smoke job should be cheap and deterministic.

tara.lee: For metric defs I'll draft updates to `docs/eval_metrics.md`:
- eval_pass_rate = (# tests within tolerance) / (# tests run)
- tolerance is per-benchmark and stored in model metadata (baseline file)
- record pass/fail per-sample so we can do bisection later

maria.nguyen: Action items: I'll open GH Actions PR for healthcheck. @josh.kim please update Buildkite plugin and add `scripts/ci/circuit_breaker.py --threshold 30`. @tara.lee can you draft the metric doc and add the Grafana panel? I'll add the `eval_ci_skips` counter in the telemetry pipeline.

josh.kim: Yep, I'll add the plugin change and a small script that queries the queue API and cancels heavy pipelines when threshold exceeded. Quick prototype command: `./scripts/ci/circuit_breaker.py --threshold 30 --dry-run`.

maria.nguyen: :eyes: Thanks. Goal to ship by EOD tomorrow. If anyone sees new stalls in the meantime ping me and drop logs.

eval-bot: incident created: #inc-1234 CI stalls detected 03:12 UTC; queue_depth=42; affected: quantize-onboard-matrix

buildkite-bot: FYI: cancelled 2 heavy pipelines (quantize-onboard) due to circuit-breaker dry-run (no-op) request from josh.kim

maria.nguyen: Good first pass. We'll follow up with a small postmortem if the regression repeats.
